description: All nutrient values for one food (energy, macronutrients, fatty acids, vitamins, minerals), per 100 g or scaled to a given amount in grams. Includes portion sizes, density, category, diet, climate impact (kg CO2e, AGRIBALYSE 3.2, for about 633 foods) and source attribution. Also six AGRIBALYSE environmental indicators per kg (water use, land use, nutrient pollution of fresh water, sea and land, acidification; reference values for the generic French equivalent, never a score) and matdata.se swaps within the category (more fibre, less salt, lower climate impact), chosen by fixed rules. Each value has quality: how the Swedish Food Agency obtained it (analysed, calculated, estimated, borrowed or not_stated; matdata_sum for omega-3), Matdata.se's summary of the agency's codes.

grams.description: Amount of the food in grams. All values, including climate impact, are scaled to this amount; the environmental indicators stay per kg. Default 100 (values per 100 g). Use the portions in the result to convert pieces or decilitres to grams.

id.description: Food id (Swedish Food Agency number) as returned by search_foods, top_foods or compare_foods, e.g. 553 for banana.
